verdict.rationale: The docs show a `local-ai models list` command for browsing the model gallery. `local-ai run` accepts huggingface:// and ollama:// URIs, which downloads and runs models from the CLI, and a --preload-models flag can fetch models at startup. Search and ongoing management are not documented for the CLI. Missing for 10: CLI search/filter of models, CLI commands to remove/update/inspect installed models, independent hands-on corroboration.
